content: Read full source of cloudflare/workers-chat-demo (src/chat.mjs, 567 lines): Worker entry parses /api/room/<name>/*, strips prefix, forwards rest to DO via roomObject.fetch(). ChatRoom DO: constructor restores sessions from state.getWebSockets()+deserializeAttachment; first client message is auth/name message, messages queued in blockedMessages until then; broadcast() iterates sessions map with webSocket.send + dead-connection pruning; monotonic timestamp Math.max(Date.now(), last+1); history via storage.list({reverse:true,limit:100}) KV-style backlog on join; separate RateLimiter DO class keyed idFromName(ip); WS handshake errors returned as 101 + error frame because devtools cannot show HTTP error body on upgrade.
